description: Ireland Nearest Analysis calculates proximity between a project area and environmental features. Quarry Consulting and Chao Gong provide a QGIS plugin that obtains EPA WFS or ArcGIS REST layers, transforms coordinates, finds nearby features and exports distances and azimuths to CSV with a map. The intended geographic coverage is Ireland, using Irish National Grid coordinates; input geometry and source-service updates determine spatial detail and time coverage. The outputs can prepare environmental constraints for related infrastructure siting and exposure simulations. Code is free under MIT, and the README assigns CC-BY-4.0 to its EPA example data. A limitation is that live service availability and layer completeness affect results. The article says standard QGIS needs no extra libraries, but the current README lists GeoPandas and other packages, so deployment requirements need checking. No site geometry, API dataset or plugin was downloaded or executed.
